content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Courses teachable

Sovereign commerce infrastructure provides a structural alternative for digital creators excluded by mainstream payment platforms. By leveraging blockchain technology and open-source tools, creators can establish their online storefronts without the constraints of payment processors like Stripe or Gumroad. This is critical for creators in regions where these platforms have abandoned the market, enabling them to sell courses, ebooks, and other digital products autonomously.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

At its core, sovereign commerce infrastructure consists of various tools that work in tandem. By using platforms like Cloudflare for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend processes, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, creators can build robust systems for sales and product delivery. This architecture ensures that every component operates seamlessly, allowing for automatic payment processing and instant product access while maintaining data ownership.
Who This Is Built For and Why

NOWPayments operates as a crypto payment processor that requires no KYC from merchants and no account creation from buyers. It supports over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT on multiple chains, Solana, BNB on Binance Smart Chain, and Tron. When a buyer initiates payment, NOWPayments creates a unique payment address for that specific transaction, monitors the blockchain in real time, and fires a webhook when payment confirms on-chain. The 0.5% fee is the only cost — no monthly fee, no setup fee, no revenue share, no payout schedule. Funds go directly to the wallet addresses you configure. COREMERCH never touches your wallet or your funds at any point before, during, or after deployment.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure allows you to bypass traditional payment barriers.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The sovereign commerce stack is a combination of free and paid tools that deliver an end-to-end solution. Key components include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Supabase or Google Sheets for order management, and NOWPayments for handling over 300 cryptocurrencies. This integration provides a streamlined experience for both sellers and buyers while ensuring compliance with regulatory environments without KYC barriers.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start selling courses without relying on Stripe or Teachable, first choose the right stack that fits your needs, such as the Edge Commerce Stack ($197). Next, set up your hosting via Cloudflare Pages, configure your payment processor with NOWPayments, and integrate your product delivery system. Finally, load your products and test the entire system to ensure it functions correctly. After your store is live, promote it on social media to reach your audience effectively.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

If Stripe is unavailable in your country, you can still sell digital products by using sovereign commerce infrastructure. This involves setting up your online store using tools like Cloudflare Pages and NOWPayments for crypto transactions, which do not have geographic restrictions. This approach allows you to operate independently without relying on conventional payment processors.
You maintain complete ownership of your digital products and customer data.

Your Deployment Checklist

Identify the right tools for your needs, such as Cloudflare Pages for hosting and NOWPayments for payment processing. Set up your online store and configure the necessary backend logic. Load your digital products and ensure your delivery system is in place. Test the entire process to confirm that payments and product access work seamlessly. Launch your store and promote it to your target audience.
